title: Ruffle 404 on GitHub Pages: ruffle.js loaded from /ruffle/ instead of /dash/ruffle/ (base-path ignored) — Live Preview/Test Movie broken on deploy
description:
FIXED (task 1362). Root cause + fix + verification below.

=== ROOT CAUSE (both defects confirmed & fixed) ===
(a) Loader URL ignored the Vite base. RufflePlayer.tsx defaulted ruffleBaseUrl to root-absolute "/ruffle"; under prod base /dash/, "/ruffle/ruffle.js" resolved to jhead.github.io/ruffle/ruffle.js (the reported 404).
(b) Ruffle bundle never materialized in the Pages artifact (apps/desktop/public/ruffle/ is gitignored; pages.yml had no copy step) -> dist/ruffle/ empty.

=== FIX ===
(a) New pure helper packages/player/src/ruffleAssetUrl.ts: resolveRuffleBaseUrl(baseUrl) + viteBaseUrl(). RufflePlayer.tsx now defaults ruffleBaseUrl to resolveRuffleBaseUrl(viteBaseUrl()) = `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}ruffle` -> /dash/ruffle in prod, /ruffle in dev/Tauri. Explicit prop still wins. @flash/player is path-aliased into the app's Vite build so BASE_URL is statically substituted. PlayerWindow.tsx JSDoc updated; helper exported from index.ts.
(b) New tools/copy-ruffle.mjs copies the bundle from the installed @ruffle-rs/ruffle pkg (resolved from @flash/player) into apps/desktop/public/ruffle/. .github/workflows/pages.yml now runs `node tools/copy-ruffle.mjs` BEFORE the web build, so Vite copies public/ruffle/ -> dist/ruffle/ at /dash/.

=== VERIFICATION ===
- Unit: packages/player/src/__tests__/ruffleAssetUrl.test.ts (7 cases) PASS. `pnpm --filter @flash/player run test` = 19 passed.
- Pages build: `node tools/copy-ruffle.mjs` then `NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @flash/desktop run build` => dist/ruffle/ruffle.js present; index.html references /dash/assets/...; emitted bundle: `const l=r??K$e(q$e())` (= ruffleBaseUrl ?? resolveRuffleBaseUrl(viteBaseUrl())) and `${l}/ruffle.js`, with `..._URL)??"/"` (viteBaseUrl) and the resolver `)?t:`${t}/`}ruffle`. node assert on built dist: resolveRuffleBaseUrl('/dash/')+'/ruffle.js' === '/dash/ruffle/ruffle.js'; '/' => '/ruffle/ruffle.js'.
- Suites: authoring-ui 1158/1158 PASS; swf 1472/1472 PASS; core 5528/5530 (3 fixture-absence ENOENT for fixtures/flash8-empty.fla, untracked in git — the permitted ~3 fixtures, unrelated to ruffle).
- Full ordered packages build green.

Tauri/desktop path preserved: Tauri/dev use base / -> /ruffle/ruffle.js (unchanged).
